evidence.claim: The standalone Claritas iMage platform features processing algorithms alongside specialized modules like Octave and STITCH to handle advanced imaging workflows (Petrosys Group).
Claritas offers full waveform inversion (FWI) operating at a higher frequency to capture variations in near-surface areas and improve depth positioning accuracy (Petrosys Group).
The Claritas V. 2026.1.1 release includes advanced velocity model export through the Tomo3D module and SEG-Y to Claritas NMO conversion utility for use within the IMAGE_K3D module (Petrosys Group).

Claritas is engineered with a modular, lightweight footprint that allows users to scale workflows from local laptops to high-performance computing clusters via parallel processing deployment (Petrosys Group).
The software features a Linux-based deployment architecture designed specifically for intensive data processing tasks in dedicated seismic processing centers (Petroleumsoftware.ir).

Petrosys does not own a proprietary multi-client data library, but instead provides the Exploration Archives software for large-scale digital preservation, indexing, and quality control of massive multi-decade seismic repositories (Petrosys Group).
The ecosystem uses the dbMap master data management application to catalog and govern expansive physical and digital seismic datasets across enterprise repositories (Petrosys Group).

Claritas provides specialized field quality control (QC) tools designed to analyze the first breaks of surface waves on-site to immediately correct bad channels or irregular geometry (Petrosys Group).
The production release of the SeisViewer 3D visualization tool allows geophysicists to review inline, crossline, and timeslice displays to evaluate processing quality dynamically (Petrosys Group).

The software features an automated AI/ML water bottom picking module named PROBPICK that uses machine learning to estimate and pick the water bottom on high-resolution and ultra-high-resolution datasets (Petrosys Group).

Petrosys Group presented a dedicated technical paper at the EAGE Digital 2026 conference titled "AI Begins Below the Surface," outlining their governance foundations for AI-driven subsurface workflows (Petrosys Group).

Quantum Geoservices is a documented user of Claritas software, deploying it on survey vessels like the MV Bergen Resolution for a $12 million seismic survey project.
Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) of India officially contracted for 20 access-right licenses of Petrosys software as detailed in its corporate annual disclosures.
Quality Seismic Consultancy Limited explicitly relies on the Claritas software package as its primary 2D and 3D processing engine for complex exploration datasets.
Petrosys is headquartered in Adelaide, Australia, and its parent brand expanded its physical Middle Eastern hub by opening a dedicated regional corporate office in Dubai, UAE in September 2026.
Claritas maintains an Eastern European deployment footprint through its licensed agent BREND-VIK LTD, which operates a dedicated seismic processing and modeling production office in Kyiv, Ukraine.
The Claritas seismic processing platform is globally recognized for being deployed across more than 75 organizations spanning 30 countries.
Prior to expanding under Petrosys and Ikon Science, the Claritas software was commercialized out of GNS Science, which recorded overall commercial and research revenues of NZD $95.4 million.

Petrosys Pty Ltd operates under the umbrella of Carina Software Group (a division of Vela Software and Constellation Software Inc.), meaning its individual financial backlogs are absorbed into a multi-billion dollar private software portfolio.

The software functions inside a rapidly growing vertical, with the global Seismic Data Processing and Imaging Software Market valued at USD $10.68 billion in 2026 and projected to reach USD $21.73 billion by 2034.
Petrosys has a strategic technical integration alliance with Geoactive to embed an Exchange connector for the globally used Interactive Petrophysics (IP) platform.
Petrosys maintains a product data exchange alliance with GeoSoftware, allowing direct seismic data transfer with interpretation tools like HampsonRussell and Jason.
Petrosys is an official Esri Partner, providing embedded GIS and spatial data mapping solutions to exploration teams across more than 300 sites worldwide.
Historically, the core Claritas product line has captured an estimated 5% market share of the specialized software market used by global oil and gas explorers to analyze seismic data.
Petrosys is categorized as a key market participant in industry studies like the Geophysical Software Service Market Report, positioned alongside Tier-1 competitors like SLB, CGG, and Halliburton.

Claritas defends its market presence by capturing niche market shares in Ultra-High-Resolution (UHR) marine surveys, catering directly to offshore wind field developers and marine geophysical survey contractors.
